install:
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dpkg::Options::="--force-confold" libsqlite3-dev libssl-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf pkg-config
rustup toolchain install stable --component rustfmt,clippy
rustup default stable
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
cargo build -p zai-server
